_comment: The single source of truth for which channels this repo manages. Added 2026-08-17, when a third channel turned up and four separate scripts each carried their own copy of a two-channel map — a drift risk that would show up as a token being refused, or worse, accepted for the wrong channel.
_secrets: Each channel gets its own OAuth secret triple, and they must never collide: overwriting one channel's set silently repoints every workflow that channel owns. An OAuth client ID and secret identify the APPLICATION, not a channel — the same client can mint tokens for all three. What binds a token to a channel is the choice made at Google's consent screen, which is why every write path re-checks the authenticated channel at runtime.
_authorize_html: automation/authorize.html carries its own copy of this map, inline. It has to: it runs from file:// where fetching a sibling JSON is blocked. test_channels_sync.py fails if the two ever disagree.

clarity.notes: Channel 3, registered 2026-08-17. Quran/Tafsir explainers, weekly. 41 subs, 16 videos, 2,473 lifetime views, joined Jan 2024, country AE. Diagnosis in clarity/channel-diagnosis.md; packaging fix applied by automation/clarity_packaging.py. Do not port either other channel's conclusions onto it: channel 1's problem is topic exhaustion at 8K+ views, channel 2's is format at 33 views, and long-form is what WORKS here.
